import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().execute();
    }

    void execute() {
        try {
            BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);
            
            int caseCounter = 1;
            while (true) {
                String[] line = reader.readLine().split("\\s+");
                int n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
                int D = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
                if (n == 0 && D == 0) break;
                
                writer.println("@" + caseCounter++);
                
                final double radius = 1;
                Point left = new Point(-D, 0);
                Point right = new Point(D, 0);
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    line = reader.readLine().split("\\s+");
                    int sl = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
                    int sr = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
                    double vLeft = sl / 180.0 * Math.PI * radius;
                    double vRight = sr / 180.0 * Math.PI * radius;
                    int time = Integer.parseInt(line[2]);
                    
                    if (Math.abs(sl - sr) < 1e-9) {
                        Point displacement = right.sub(left).rotate(Math.PI / 2).normalize().scale((vLeft + vRight) * 0.5 * time);
                        left = left.add(displacement);
                        right = right.add(displacement);
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    double offset = D * (vLeft + vRight) / (vLeft - vRight);
                    Point center = left.add(right).scale(0.5);
                    Point pivot = center.add(right.sub(center).normalize().scale(offset));
                    
                    Point leftVec = left.sub(pivot);
                    Point rightVec = right.sub(pivot);
                    double wLeft = vLeft / leftVec.length();
                    double wRight = vRight / rightVec.length();
                    
                    leftVec = leftVec.rotate(wLeft * time);
                    rightVec = rightVec.rotate(wRight * time);
                    
                    left = leftVec.add(pivot);
                    right = rightVec.add(pivot);
                }
                
                Point mid = left.add(right).scale(0.5);
                writer.printf("%.10f%n", mid.x);
                writer.printf("%.10f%n", mid.y);
            }
            writer.close();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    static class Point {
        double x, y;

        Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        Point add(Point other) { return new Point(x + other.x, y + other.y); }
        Point sub(Point other) { return new Point(x - other.x, y - other.y); }
        
        Point rotate(double angle) {
            double cos = Math.cos(angle);
            double sin = Math.sin(angle);
            return new Point(x * cos - y * sin, x * sin + y * cos);
        }
        
        Point normalize() {
            double len = length();
            if (len < 1e-12) return new Point(0, 0);
            return scale(1.0 / len);
        }
        
        Point scale(double factor) { return new Point(factor * x, factor * y); }
        
        double length() { return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y); }
    }
}
